# Ability Tokens

**Ability tokens** are special resources generated by bees that can be collected to activate unique abilities and buffs for the player. Most bees spawn these tokens, with exceptions being ungifted Basic Bees and Brave Bees without Beequips. If a player does not collect a token within a certain amount of time, it fades away.

Tokens are client-sided; players cannot collect tokens generated by other players' bees, and vice versa. Prior to the May 7th, 2018 update, other players' tokens were visible but still uncollectible.

Some tokens are not generated by player bees (e.g., honey tokens from flowers). Player-generated tokens give off gold sparkles, while non-bee-generated tokens do not. All visible tokens are collectible, though a bug sometimes prevents the collection of certain loot tokens during Honeystorms or Snowstorms.

***
*Disclaimer: This content contains information obtained through datamining and may be inaccurate or outdated. Technical details (like token counts for Impale, Rain Cloud, Tornado, etc., and specific cooldowns/success rates) are based on external spreadsheets dated December 19th, 2024.*

*Assumptions made: Much of the technical information provided is based on Onett's Discord messages, most of which are dated back to 2018. The assumption is that this information remains accurate today.*

## Mechanics and Variables

### Spawning Categories
Ability tokens fall into three categories based on when a bee can spawn them:

*   **Gather:** Tokens generated while bees are collecting pollen from flowers. Most Gather tokens help collect or boost pollen collection.
*   **Battle:** Tokens generated while bees are targeting or attacking mobs. These often inflict damage or debuffs and boost combat effectiveness.
*   **Idle:** Tokens generated when bees are not performing any other activities (gathering, attacking, converting, etc.).

Some ability tokens can fall into multiple categories.

### Spawning Attempts
When a bee pauses after movement (to gather, attack, or turn), it attempts to spawn its ability tokens. Each token has three variables that dictate its spawning frequency:

*   **Use Cooldown:** The time required after the token is spawned before the bee can attempt to summon it again.
*   **Attempt Cooldown:** The waiting period between consecutive spawn attempts for a specific token.
*   **Attempt Success Rate:** The probability that an attempt succeeds. If successful, the token is added to the bee's pool of available tokens.

When attempting to spawn, the bee checks all possible tokens to see if their use and attempt cooldowns have expired. If they have, it attempts a spawn. If successful, the token enters the pool. After checking all abilities, the bee randomly selects one token from its pool to spawn, removing that token while keeping others available for the next cycle. The spawned token then begins its use cooldown.

The average time an ability token takes to spawn is calculated using this formula:
$$time = useCooldown + attemptCooldown \times {\frac {1}{attemptSuccessRate}}$$

## Stats Modifiers

These stats affect the characteristics and frequency of ability tokens.

### Bee Ability Rate
This stat increases or decreases how often bees spawn their ability tokens by modifying the cooldowns and success rate. For example, a 200% Bee Ability Rate reduces an ability's use and attempt cooldown to 50% of its original value (100% ÷ 200%) and doubles its success rate (+100%).

### Ability Token Lifespan
This extends the duration of uncollected tokens before they despawn. It can be boosted by Gifted Bees, Stubborn Bees, Cog Amulets, Paper Angel/Paperclip Beequips, or temporarily via the Drooping Stubborn Bee Sticker. The maximum possible lifespan is 145%.

### Ability Duplication Chance
When this chance is active, ability tokens randomly spawn duplicated variants on the field. Duped tokens last for double the original token's lifespan, and that duration increases by 5% per Digital Bee level. Duped tokens can be collected/activated by standing beneath them for 1 second.

Duplication chance can be increased by Field Corruption (from Digital Bee's Glitch and Map Corruption), Gifted Digital Bees, or the 'Corrupt' upgrade from the Robo Bear Challenge. It is also provided by Science Bear during his quest on specific fields.

### Bee Movespeed
While not directly related to token effects, higher Bee Movespeed allows bees to make more attempts at creating Ability Tokens, thereby increasing the overall average spawn rate of tokens.

## Token Details

### Bomb (Red, Blue, Buzz)
**Category:** Gather
**Description:** Collects pollen from flowers in an area and grants the Bomb Combo buff.
*   **Buzz Bombs:** Collect 7 pollen from all flower types.
*   **Red Bombs:** Collect 10 pollen only from Red flowers.
*   **Blue Bombs:** Collect 10 pollen only from Blue flowers.

Pollen collected increases by 10% per bee level (e.g., 200% on a Level 20 bee).
*   **Range Variants:** Standard Bomb tokens collect from 13 surrounding flowers; Bomb+ tokens collect from 29 surrounding flowers.

**Sources:**
*   **Bees:** Red Bombs are granted by Rascal, Demon, and Shy Bees. Blue Bombs by Bumble, Bubble, and Buoyant Bees. Buzz Bombs by Bomber, Commander, and Exhausted Bees. Variants (Bomb+ / Bomb) are available from Fire, Festive, Frosty, Ninja, Vicious, Demo, Lion, and Fuzzy Bees.
*   **Other:** Balloons during a Surprise Party can generate Blue or Buzz Bombs. Many Beequips provide these abilities (e.g., Bang Snaps grant any color Bomb/Bomb+; Smiley Stickers grant Blue Bomb; Bottle Caps grant Buzz Bomb).

**Sync Mechanics:** Red Bomb Sync causes all Red Bombs to collect white pollen. Blue Bomb Sync does the same for Blue Bombs. If both are active, all bombs collect any color of pollen.
**Pollen Haze Effect:** When Pollen Haze is active, all Bomb tokens are automatically collected and may pollinate flowers.

| Variant | Use Cooldown | Attempt Cooldown | Success Rate | Average Spawn Rate | Lifespan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Standard Bomb** | 8 seconds | 4 seconds | 25% | 1 token every 20 seconds | 4 seconds |

### Boost (Red, Blue, White)
**Category:** Gather
**Description:** Grants the player a matching-color Boost buff, which buffs pollen collection for that color. Red/Blue/White sparkles appear on the player's bees and character upon collection.

**Sources:**
*   **Bees:** Red Boost from Rad, Riley, and Shy Bees. Blue Boost from Frosty, Cool, Bucko, Diamond, and Tadpole Bees. White Boost only from Windy Bee.
*   **Other:** Balloons during a Surprise Party can generate White or Blue Boost tokens. Unactivated targets from Target Practice spawn Red Boost tokens. Festive Gifts and Festive Marks often reward Red Boost tokens. Many Beequips provide these abilities (e.g., Berets grant Blue Boost; Leis grant Red or Blue Boost).

**Flower Tokens:** Flowers sometimes generate Boost tokens instead of Honey tokens. These look similar to bee-generated ones but lack gold sparkles, and they fade slower. They do not count for Ability Token quests/badges. Token Links only collect player-generated tokens.

| Variant | Use Cooldown | Attempt Cooldown | Success Rate | Average Spawn Rate | Lifespan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Standard Boost** | 4.5 seconds | 4.5 seconds | 33.33% | 1 token every 13.5 seconds | 4 seconds |

### Token Link
**Category:** Gather, Battle
**Description:** Collects all other ability tokens (except for other Token Links). Grants 25 honey plus an additional 10 honey per bee level for each token collected this way.

*   **Stacking Note:** Tokens are collected based on their spawn time. If multiple link tokens are collected simultaneously, they may link the same tokens; however, the other tokens activate only once, while the player receives two sets of honey from the link tokens.
*   **Exclusions:** It does not collect honey tokens generated by Coin Scatter, Gummy Star, or Target Practice.

**Sources:**
*   **Bees:** Exhausted, Rage, Shocked, and Music Bees.
*   **Other:** Balloons during a Surprise Party can generate Token Link tokens. Paper Angels, Paperclips, and Bead Lizards provide this ability via Beequips.

| Variant | Use Cooldown | Attempt Cooldown | Success Rate | Average Spawn Rate | Lifespan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Standard Token Link** | 5 seconds | 5 seconds | 33.33% | 1 token every 15 seconds | 4 seconds |

### Mark (Pollen Mark, Honey Mark)
**Category:** Gather
**Description:** Deploys a Mark on the field that grants a specific buff when the player stands in its range. Marks can be stacked by overlapping them; if linked, all marks activate simultaneously.

*   **Pollen Mark:** Grants the Pollen Mark buff (increases all pollen).
*   **Honey Mark:** Grants the Honey Mark buff (grants conversion links and increases Convert Rate). When leaving the range, conversion links remain active until finished, but the player loses the Convert Rate buff.

**Variants:**
*   **Mark Variant:** Lasts 7 seconds (+0.2s per bee level) with a 14-stud radius.
*   **Mark+ Variant:** Lasts 8 seconds (+0.25s per bee level) with an 18-stud radius.

**Sources:**
*   **Pollen Mark:** Stubborn and Carpenter Bees. Pollen Mark+ from Vector Bee.
*   **Honey Mark:** Honey and Festive Bees. Honey Mark+ from Carpenter Bee.
*   **Other:** Balloons during a Surprise Party can generate these tokens. Smiley Stickers provide the Honey Mark ability via Beequips.

| Variant | Use Cooldown | Attempt Cooldown | Success Rate | Average Spawn Rate | Lifespan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Standard Mark** | 20 seconds | 5 seconds | 25% | 1 token every 35 seconds | 8 seconds |

### Target Practice
**Category:** Battle, Gather
**Description:** Exclusive to Precise Bee. When collected on a field, the bee projects three targets (closest to farthest). Walking on and passing these targets activates them.
*   **Field Activation:** All activated targets are shot by the bee, collecting pollen from 29 surrounding flowers and spawning a Focus token. Pollen collected is x2 Precise Bee's Attack, increased by +10% per level. Flame Heat increases this up to x4 pollen and grants instant conversion.
*   **Inactive Targets:** Inactive targets spawn Red Boost tokens instead.
*   **Player Shot (On Target):** All ability tokens are collected, and the player's current Flame Heat buff is used to instantly convert pollen from their container, with half turning into 5 honey tokens around the shot target. Conversion amount scales based on Total Convert + Precise Bee's convert amount, increased by consumed Flame Heat and Field Boost stacks.
*   **Full Activation:** Grants a stack of Precision (extra Super-Crit Chance).
*   **Off-Field Collection:** If collected outside or if the bee is off-field, the player immediately receives either Precision (20% chance) or Focus (80% chance).

| Variant | Use Cooldown | Attempt Cooldown | Success Rate | Average Spawn Rate | Lifespan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Standard Target Practice** | 24 seconds | 6 seconds | 25% | 1 token every 42 seconds | 8 seconds |

#### Precise Mark
If Precise Bee is Gifted, activating the farthest target summons a Precise Mark for 12 seconds (+0.5s per level) with an 18-stud radius. Activating this mark grants the Precise Mark buff (extra Critical Chance and Super-Crit Chance).

### Rain Cloud
**Category:** Gather
**Description:** Exclusive to Windy Bee. Summons a Cloud on a field different from the one where the token was collected. The probability of which field is chosen depends on the starting field (see detailed table in original source). When active, it affects the chosen field's environment.

| Variant | Use Cooldown | Attempt Cooldown | Success Rate | Average Spawn Rate | Lifespan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Standard Rain Cloud** | 45 seconds | 20 seconds | 50% | 1 token every 65 seconds | 24 seconds |

### Tornado
**Category:** Gather, Battle
**Description:** Exclusive to Windy Bee. Spends all player Haste stacks to summon a tornado at the token's position (if on a field). The tornado moves around the field, dealing damage to mobs and collecting pollen/tokens from a 5-tile radius every second. It also collects pollen from balloons it passes through.
*   **Scaling:** Speed, damage, duration, and collected pollen are calculated based on Haste stacks spent ($x$) and bee level ($y$).
    *   Multiplier: $1 + 0.1 \times ({\frac {y-1}{19}})^2$
    *   Duration: $10+x\times 0.4+{\frac {x^{1.4}}{3.2}}$, plus 2 if $\ge 1$ Haste stack is spent.
    *   Damage: $\lfloor 10+y^{1.5} \rfloor$ (base damage).
    *   Pollen Collected per second: $\lfloor 3.5+{\frac {y}{3}} \rfloor$, multiplied by the multiplier.
    *   Damage to enemy per second: $\lfloor 0.5+\text{damage}+(20+y^{1.5}\times 1.75-\text{damage})\times ({\frac {x}{3}})^2 \rfloor$.
    *   Movement Speed: $7+18\times {\frac {x}{10}}$ studs per second.
    *   Final Lifespan: $\lfloor duration\times multiplier+0.5 \rfloor$ seconds.
*   **Note:** If collected outside or above a field, it does not summon a tornado but still spends Haste stacks.

| Variant | Use Cooldown | Attempt Cooldown | Success Rate | Average Spawn Rate | Lifespan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Standard Tornado** | 80 seconds | 10 seconds | 33.33% | 1 token every 100 seconds | 24 seconds |

### Glitch
**Category:** Gather, Battle
**Description:** Exclusive to Digital Bee. Corrupts the player's current field for 20 seconds (+1s per level). A glitch effect occasionally appears on the field; every ability token collected in this field has a chance to be duplicated ("Duped"), and Digital Bees can spawn $\text{☺}$ tokens.
*   **Corruption:** Corruption can be increased via Drives (Colored Drives increase corruption matching flower color; Glitched Drives increase all fields).

| Variant | Use Cooldown | Attempt Cooldown | Success Rate | Average Spawn Rate | Lifespan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Standard Glitch** | 60 seconds | 10 seconds | 33.33% | 1 token every 80 seconds | 12 seconds |

### Map Corruption
**Category:** Gather
**Description:** Exclusive to Gifted Digital Bee. Corrupts a random field for 3 minutes (+15s per level) for all players on the server. The corruption amount can be increased via Drives.
*   **Drive Effects:** Colored Drives increase the likelihood of corrupting fields with matching flowers; Glitched Drives make the chosen field completely random but grant 25% more corruption.

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Standard Map Corruption** | 360 seconds | 15 seconds | 12.5% | 1 token every 465 seconds | 24 seconds |

### Mind Hack
**Category:** Battle
**Description:** Exclusive to Digital Bee. "Hacks" up to 3 nearby enemies (+1 per 3 levels), stunning them for 3 seconds (+0.1s per level). While stunned, enemies take 25% more damage (+0.1% per Glitched Drive enhancement). Hacking is less effective against bosses. This token also spawns a $\text{☺}$ token if collected inside the field.

| Variant | Use Cooldown | Attempt Cooldown | Success Rate | Average Spawn Rate | Lifespan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Standard Mind Hack** | 90 seconds | 2 seconds | 33.33% | 1 token every 94 seconds | 16 seconds |

### $\text{☺}$ (Smile Tokens)
**Description:** Exclusive to Digital Bee, only generated as a duped token inside a corrupted field. When collected, they temporarily: increase Field Corruption and activate all duped tokens; hack a nearby non-boss enemy (similar effect to Mind Hack); and collect/double pollen equal to 50% of the Digital Bee's gather amount (+50% pollen multiplier per activated duped token) in specific flower arrangements.
*   **Frequency:** Increases with Glitched Drives. Average base delay is 22 seconds, reducing to 14 seconds at maxed Glitched Drives.

| Variant | Use Cooldown | Attempt Cooldown | Success Rate | Average Spawn Rate | Lifespan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Standard $\text{☺}$** | N/A (Inferred) | N/A (Inferred) | N/A (Inferred) | Approx. 22 seconds (Base) | ~4 seconds |

This buff can also be obtained from using Snowflakes during the Beesmas event, granting an additional 10 seconds of Cool Breeze per use.

### Festive Mark
**Description:** Exclusive to Festive Bees equipped with the Festive Wreath Beequip. Deploys a Festive Mark in a random field area for 12 seconds (+0.5s per level) with a ~22-tile radius. Standing within its range grants the Festive Mark buff, providing extra Honey Per Pollen, Bomb Pollen, Red Bomb Pollen, Instant Bomb Conversion, and Conversion Links.
*   **Unique Features:** Unlike other marks, this mark's effects are visible to all players, it can link with other players' marks, and it summons random gifts within its range (including Red Boost Tokens every 4th token). The buff cannot be stacked even if multiple Festive Marks overlap.

| Variant | Use Cooldown | Attempt Cooldown | Success Rate | Average Spawn Rate | Lifespan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Standard Festive Mark** | 300 seconds | 30 seconds | 16.67% | 1 token every 450 seconds | 16 seconds |

### Reindeer Fetch (Enhanced Fetch)
**Description:** The Fetch ability enhanced by equipping the Reindeer Antlers Beequip on a Puppy Bee. The ball glows bright red and emits white sparkles. Every combo grants the player the Reindeer Guidance buff, which provides extra capacity. High combos can spawn a Gingerbread Bear token (max 1 per day), allowing for up to 512 treats instead of the usual 256.

## Trivia
*   Stacking 10 marks will grant the Saturn Sticker.
*   Fuzz Bombs were previously called "Dust Bunnies."
*   The description for Red Bomb Sync used to contain an Easter Egg referencing apples, which was later corrected in updates.
*   The audio for Festive Gift, Festive Blessing, and Beesmas Cheer are derived from parts of the Christmas song "Deck the Halls."
